decision: Localize the comic wordplay using the literal cow connection. The preceding runner insists on becoming a bullfighter; the reveal shows an enormous horned, colored sea-slug creature. Its reply becomes Sea cow. so the English reader retains the comic link to the earlier bullfighter declaration.
inference_scope: This is an editorial inference from the actual consecutive source panels, not a confirmed author commentary. It does not establish an official monster name, identify a biological mammal, assign a game speaker identity, or change the project creature glossary.
scoped_game_text_search_limit: Zero hits in the four route scripts and shared MESFILE for the searched spellings does not prove the absence of an official creature name in all code/art/versions.

external_linguistic_evidence.title: Marine Ecology Research Institute: Marine trivia Vol.86 (2021), page2
external_linguistic_evidence.supports: The reading umiushi refers to gastropod molluscs; one suggested origin connects the antennae to cattle horns. The separate reading kaigyu refers to marine mammals. This supports the name's cow association, not the comic author's intent or an official game localization.
